_note: The SOAP handler was unreachable or errored. The important property is that the gateway surfaces a 5xx rather than a malformed 200 — a partner must never receive a success status carrying a failure. Assert the status class, not the body; the exact payload is build-dependent.

_related_statuses.504: The handler was reached but answered too slowly. Legacy handlers built for batch use often do — check the route timeout before concluding the upstream is down.
_related_statuses.415: The handler rejected the content type. Confirm proxy-rewrite sets text/xml; SOAP 1.2 handlers want application/soap+xml.
_related_statuses.500: The handler errored. Suspect double conversion (a json-to-xml added alongside the bidirectional xml-to-json), a missing SOAPAction header, or request field names that don't match the elements it reads.
